corrections.text: The article states Sicilia's 'Star Wars' remarks were delivered 'at Deutsche Bank's 2026 Technology Conference on September 1.' The cited source (The Register, published September 1, 2026) says only that Sicilia 'told investors last week' — it does not state the conference occurred on September 1, and 'last week' relative to the publication date indicates the remarks were made several days earlier, not on September 1 itself.
